about: Interface name to PortPosition { slot, subslot, index }, per paste platform, read by client/src/document/portTies.ts to suggest port ties. A rule suggests only when source names a vendor page with the date it was read (ADR-0034's rule). A rule with source null never suggests; its wanted line is the page the owner is asked for. Numbers are capture groups of pattern. No fuzzy matching and no first-free-port: a name no cited rule reads stays untied.

source.cite: Juniper Networks, "Understanding Interface Naming Conventions on EX Series Switches" (Junos 13.2): type-fpc/pic/port, FPC 0 on a standalone switch, PIC 0 for built-in ports, top row even and bottom row odd. Accepted by the owner on the sign-off page, round 27.

Juniper Networks, "SRX300 Series and SRX550M Interface Modules Support": type-slot/pim/port, pim equals 0. Covers plug-in Mini-PIM/GPIM slots; on-board ports as slot 0 not yet found on an official page. Owner accepted it as is on the sign-off page, round 27.
Ubiquiti, ER-8 Quick Start Guide: ports headed "RJ45 (eth0 - eth7 Ports)", "the port labeled eth0". Read for the ER-8 only; the owner accepted it for every EdgeRouter on the sign-off page, round 27.
